J1 proxy on existing checkpoints (user: proxy on checkpoints before any formal run): real_row4s3cb/checkpoint_b and syn_row4s3cb/checkpoint_b fine-tuned with GaME's keyframe optimisation in two arms -- control = this session's keyframes only (S3, the decided version's form, nothing frozen) and joint = every stored keyframe with pose corrections for earlier sessions' keyframes (J1) + frozen inherited object states / ended rows (A2) + prune-to-end (P1). Same seeds, same iterations in both arms (real: keyframe_iters 50 x 189 B keyframes = 9450; synthetic: 10000, shorter than 50 x 632 to fit the GPU hour). Then the official readouts: real = tsdf_export (every keyframe, median) + official G1 scorer; synthetic = the timeline snapshot (all views) + the unchanged harness. No readout or evaluation is changed.

J1: MonoGS (Matsuki et al. CVPR 2024, arXiv 2312.06741) Sec. 3.3.3 mapping jointly minimises over the keyframes' poses T_CW in SE(3) and the Gaussians G; tracking = 'direct optimisation against the 3D Gaussians'. Constants: lr cam_rot_delta 0.003, cam_trans_delta 0.001 (metres, here x the config scale), converged_threshold 1e-4 (configs/rgbd/tum/base_config.yaml, utils/pose_utils.py update_pose), fetched 10-07. Camera correction exp(tau) @ w2c rendered as the Gaussians moved by W = c2w exp(tau) w2c (equal by construction: p_cam = w2c W X = exp(tau) w2c X; checked numerically). A2: Khronos archived object nodes / fork session_refusion.cpp:138-148, 789-792 (the present builds objects only from this session's frames). P1: T1's rule that the map of a keyframe's time keeps what existed then. O2: fork step 1 cut before t_L, R15 (:1071-1081). No constant tuned on our data.

Real B official 92.42 vs line 93.61 while the same map from its own B keyframes scores 94.46 (and A-only 90.54); real C official 94.57 vs C-only 95.12 / A-only 92.81 / B-only 89.38; synthetic B official 87.76 (P 82.5) vs B-only 88.44 (P 95.7) and A-only 85.54 (P 81.9). The stored keyframes of earlier sessions were untrained views of the final map under S3; the official readouts render them. Retire rules and loss tweaks never touched this (records 10-07).
tsdf_export unchanged (reads kf['pose'], which J1 updates in place as any SLAM keyframe pose); G1 scorer unchanged; synthetic harness unchanged; timeline readout unchanged.

analysis/j1/{real_control,real_joint,syn_control,syn_joint}/: proxy.json (iterations, rows, frozen, pose correction stats), checkpoint.pt (stripped), export ply + G1 json (real) / eval/geometry/FINAL_GEOMETRY.csv (synthetic); queue log analysis/j1/queue.out. Deleted after the readouts are recorded (keep proxy.json and the G1/geometry csv).

analysis/j1/checks_real_b.json: (a) camera-vs-Gaussian transform renders equal: depth |diff| q50 0.0001 cm, q99 0.005 cm, alpha max 0.008; tau=0 exact; (b) d loss/d tau autograd vs central differences agree in sign and size (h=1e-3: rel err 4-18 %, the rasterizer is only piecewise smooth); (c) frozen rows bitwise unchanged after optimize_model(40) over all keyframes, live rows move, no NaN, 18 A keyframes corrected; (d) prune policy: earlier-session rows ended+frozen, this session's deleted; (e) membership unit test (tests/test_t1_birth_and_extractor.py) updated to O2 and passing; the other test files pass.

One job at a time under GPU.lock. Real arms ~10-15 min each (9450 it); synthetic arms ~25 min each (10000 it, 3.57 M rows, peak was 9.9 GB); exports + scoring ~10 min per arm. Total ~1.5 h. Disk: 4 stripped checkpoints ~1-5 GB each, deleted after the readouts.

REAL (official G1 5 cm, B): control reproduces the earlier dn_proxy control 92.13 within 0.2 (sanity). Joint >= control + 1.0 and >= 93.11 -> GO for the formal chain; joint >= 93.61 = the user's line. Prediction: joint P 93.0-93.5, F1 93.4-93.7. Cross-set consistency: joint map exported from A views only and from B views only differ in P by <= 1.5 pp (control: 91.27 vs 96.61). Pose corrections (A keyframes): translation median <= 5 cm, rotation median <= 2 deg; larger = the model is absorbing something that is not pose. SYNTHETIC (harness Mesh F1@5, B): joint P >= 89.95 (row 1) and F1 >= 90.25 (row 3) -> GO; drift of the corrections with exact poses: translation median <= 1 cm, rotation median <= 0.2 deg, else the Adam step on noise gradients is too large and the form is revisited before any chain. STOP RULE: a failed gate is analysed by the per-view split, not fixed by a new mechanism.

The first Adam step on tau moves by about lr regardless of gradient size (0.17 cm / 0.3 deg per step in check (c)); the synthetic drift gate measures whether this matters. SH features are not rotated with the Gaussians under tau (second order). The label table stays dense per row (synthetic 152 columns): memory watched.
